subject: Private deployment resourcing: scenario planner & action needed
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment resourcing: scenario planner & action needed

Team —

ACME is asking for a concrete resourcing and architecture breakdown for a potential private delivery (VPC + on-prem connector). They want: a) a pilot plan to run in their isolated VPC for a single product line, b) an enterprise rollout estimate (N deployments, multi-region), and c) an air-gapped package estimate if pilot completes successfully.

Why now: they want numbers and a recommended path to present to procurement next Thursday (2026-08-22). Sales needs a short mutual action plan and honest ceilings on what we can commit to for pilot SLA and support.

What I need from each of you by EOD Tuesday (2026-08-17):
- Karthik: three architecture scenarios (pilot, scaled enterprise, air-gapped) with rough node counts, required infra (network, storage), and key integration points we’d need from ACME (e.g., internal KMS, dedicated peering).
- Jordan: product/ops asks and any feature gating (rollouts, telemetry, upgrade path) and an estimate of dev effort (FTE-weeks) to enable the pilot scenario.
- Kimberly: security/compliance gating list and which artifacts we can provide immediately (SOC2, pen test summary, data flow diagrams) vs what requires extra work.

Attached is a starter workbook with scenario tabs — fill or annotate the relevant rows. I will consolidate and turn this into a one-pager for ACME and a simple MAP for Sales.

Attachments: [attachment: private-deploy-scenarios.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment resourcing: scenario planner & action needed

Marissa —

Thanks, added a rough pass. High-level notes (inline in the sheet and pasted below):

Pilot (minimal):
- 1 dedicated inference pool (multi-GPU rack), 1 control-plane VM, 1 observability VM. Expect 2-3 GPU instances (A100/40GB equivalent) for 99th percentile latency targets if we keep batching conservative.
- Network: customer VPC peering and a single encrypted tunnel to our control plane; we require egress for kernel and metric updates.
- Ops: we anticipate requiring 1x SRE for onboarding (3 weeks) + 0.5x SRE for 3 months of post-launch rotation.

Enterprise (scaled):
- Multi-region replica pools, auto-scaling groups per tenant, centralized metrics ingestion (higher OPS overhead). 4–6 GPUs per region as baseline.
- Dedicated on-call + runbook (2 FTEs ongoing).

Air-gapped:
- Packaging for no-external-egress: additional engineering effort to create an offline installer and airgapped observability sinks. Estimate: +6–8 weeks dev time and a larger ops runway to support upgrades.

Open questions that will materially change estimates:
- Does ACME provide HSM/KMS or do we need to integrate to their vaults? If we must broker keys, that adds ~2 weeks engineering and potentially cross-team approvals.
- Will ACME accept our lightweight agent or insist on a full on-prem runtime with on-site install support?

I attached a short cost sketch. Happy to sync if helpful.

Attachment: [attachment: pilot-ops-cost-estimate.pdf (application/pdf)]

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment resourcing: scenario planner & action needed

Marissa / Karthik —

Great write-up. From product/solutions POV, a couple of pragmatic asks to make the MAP saleable to ACME:

1) Pilot acceptance criteria (we need a 4–6 bullet list we can write into the SOW): uptime target, latency baseline (p90/p95), data retention policy, and a success metric (e.g., 10k inference/day with <250ms p95 for the primary model).
2) Upgrade & rollback story — customers will ask how we handle breaking changes. For pilot we should offer weekly patch windows and a documented rollback plan.
3) Observability contract — what traces/metrics do we commit to expose? This ties to Karthik's oncall ask.

Resource ask: proposal for Sales to present to ACME this week — commit 0.5 PM (Jordan) + 0.5 Solutions Eng + 1 SRE for the pilot ramp period (6–8 weeks). If ACME signs enterprise, move to 2 SRE + 1 PM ongoing. Those numbers come from past pilots (GreenBank, Arbor Health) and are conservative but defensible.

I converted Karthik's three scenarios into a short MAP (attached as a link in the workbook). Also flagged the KMS question as high impact.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Product Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment resourcing: scenario planner & action needed

Team —

Security/compliance quick confirmation: we can surface SOC2 Type II summary, recent pen test redacted report, and a standard data flow diagram immediately. For air-gapped we will need to create a tailored DFD and run an internal exception review (policy) — that is a 2–3 week gating item.

Checklist highlights (I'll hand off the doc with owners):
- Required for pilot: SOC2 summary, network topology, minimal data retention policy, and attacker surface notes.
- Required for enterprise: ID proofing of ACME admin accounts and a completed vendor risk assessment.
- Air-gapped path: formal exception + signed change management runbook from ACME + joint rollback test.

I attached a short checklist. If we propose the resource bands Jordan suggested, Security is comfortable to sign off on the pilot SOW pending the KMS decision and a basic infra diagram.

Attachments: [attachment: security-gating-checklist.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Kimberly Park

Redwood Inference
